notes: True homograph of the existing H4185 ("depart, mostly of inanimate things"), both spelled מוש -- added as מוש¹ (lower Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H4185 is retroactively renamed מוש² in this same batch.

Gloss collision: "touch" (qal) matches the existing נגע (H5060) root gloss exactly -- disambiguating search alias added. "handle" (hiphil) also overlaps the existing תפש (H8610) piel stem_gloss, and "touch" overlaps H4185/מוש²'s own sibling hiphil stem_gloss "touch" -- both stem-level only, no alias needed for those.
